demo.tipp: Tip: if a target for a required link is missing, first create folders of the target type (or create load test folders for it too). Ablago never creates passwords; a required password can only be filled by hand.
verwaltung.sicherung.alt: The last backup is too old.
verwaltung.tresor: The key for encryption is missing or doesn’t match.
verwaltung.export: The export folder is inside the backup folder – unencrypted exports go along with every copy of the backup.
verwaltung.postfach: The mailbox “{name}” needs a new sign-in.
verwaltung.fehlermeldungen_one: An error report from a user is waiting.
verwaltung.fehlermeldungen_other: {anzahl} error reports from users are waiting.
verwaltung.notfall: An emergency access is still open.
verwaltung.texterkennung_one: One document has an error in text recognition.
verwaltung.texterkennung_other: {anzahl} documents have an error in text recognition.
verwaltung.ohne-leserecht: A task is with {name}, without read access to the folder.
verwaltungsmodus.liste.text: Who, in administration mode, opened, downloaded, changed, exported or sent folders they otherwise wouldn’t be allowed to see. These entries can’t be deleted.
demo.seiten-dokumente-in-der: {seiten} pages, {texterkennung} documents in the text recognition queue, documents in {dauer}
demo.ohne-pdftoppm-scans-und: Without pdftoppm: scans and images were created as simple PDFs.
demo.erzeugt-mappen-fuer-die: Creates folders for the existing folder types – with suitable values per field and links to existing folders, optionally with documents. That way you can observe how Ablago behaves with many folders and documents. Load test folders are marked and can be removed together again.
demo.laeuft-im-hintergrund-du: {b} … runs in the background; you can also leave the page.
demo.vertragspartner-vertrag-rechnung-un: Contract partner, contract, invoice and payment with tabs and a few folders. Only possible as long as there are no folder types of your own yet. If there is a storage location (e.g. from an older Library), contracts and invoices get the field “Whereabouts of original documents” and a few storage locations.
demo.bis-50-000-je: up to 50,000 per run, distributed across the folder types; records get more than master data
demo.optional-gleicher-startwert-ergibt: The same start value gives the same data, so that measurements are comparable
demo.nur-fuer-mappentypen-mit: (only for folder types with a documents tab)
demo.bewegst-du-einen-regler: If you move a slider, the others adjust in their previous proportion. Total:
demo.die-texterkennung-vieler-gescannter: Text recognition of many “scanned” PDFs and images takes days rather than hours on a NAS; it then runs in the background. Backups get correspondingly larger.
demo.mit-seiten-zusammen-seiten: , ≈ {dokumente} with ≈ {seiten} pages, together ≈ {groesse}; ≈ {ocrSeiten} pages for text recognition
demo.frei-frei-bleiben-muessen: Free: {groesse}; at least {groesse2} must stay free.
demo.der-speicherplatz-reicht-dafuer: There isn’t enough storage for this. Choose fewer folders, fewer documents or a lighter mix.
demo.ohne-pdftoppm-nur-in: Without pdftoppm (only in development) scans and images are created as simple PDFs.
demo.loescht-alle-demo-mappen: Deletes all {demo} load test folders including their documents, in batches of 1,000. Real folders stay untouched; if a real folder links to a load test folder, nothing is deleted.
fehlermeldungen.was-benutzer-gemeldet-ha: What users have reported, with technical details.
fehlermeldungen.die-meldung-wird-samt: The report is permanently deleted together with its images.
protokoll.letzte-24-stunden-hoechstens: Last 24 hours, at most 10,000 entries ({gespeichert} stored). Newest at the top.
protokoll.dieser-eintrag-ist-nicht: This entry isn’t in the list (any more).
protokoll.alle-eintraege-dieser-anfrage: Show all entries of this request
protokoll.waehle-links-einen-eintrag: Pick an entry on the left to see all details. Every line is also in the NAS’s container logs; there they stay even after a restart.
protokoll.eingeschaltet-bis-uhr-danach: On until {uhrzeit}. After that it switches itself off.
protokoll.im-debug-modus-kommen: In debug mode detailed entries are added: every request with its duration and number of database queries, loaded views, displayed documents. Good for reproducing an error; it switches itself off again after an hour.
speicherplatz.nicht-messbar-ordner-fehlt: can’t be measured (folder missing or not readable)
speicherplatz.wartungsmodus-beendet-alle: Maintenance mode ended – everyone can work again.
speicherplatz.wie-es-dem-server: How the server is doing right now. {b} Ablago measures every minute and before every upload how much space is free in its folders. Below the {b2} there is a notice here and in the overview, plus a mail to all administrators. Below the {b3} uploading is blocked at once, and after 5 minutes’ notice maintenance mode starts (“Storage limit reached”).
speicherplatz.hochladen-ist-gesperrt-sch: {b} Uploading is blocked. Make room – delete old {link}, empty the {link2}, {link3} – or enlarge the NAS’s storage. Afterwards you end the {link4} yourself.
speicherplatz.noch-arbeiten-alle-normal: {b} Everyone is still working normally. Make room in good time, before the limit ({schwelleText} free) is reached.
speicherplatz.der-wartungsmodus-wegen-de: {b} Maintenance mode because of storage space is still running – it doesn’t end by itself. End maintenance?
speicherplatz.gilt-fuer-jeden-ordner: Applies to each folder separately; percentages refer to the size of its drive. Default: warning below 10 % free, limit below 2 GB free.
speicherplatz.die-ordner-im-container: The folders in the container are fixed; which NAS folder they point to is set by the volumes of the Compose file. The database lives in its own container and can’t be measured from here – if everything is on the same disk (usual on a NAS), this measurement is enough.
speicherplatz.kein-eigenes-volume-geht: · not a volume of its own – lost when the container is recreated!
speicherplatz.die-sicherungen-liegen-auf: The backups are on the same disk as the documents.
speicherplatz.faellt-sie-aus-sind: {b} If it fails, both are gone – copy the backup folder to another disk or off site.
speicherplatz.kein-eigenes-volume-geht-2: {wert}not a volume of its own – lost when the container is recreated!
speicherplatz.davon-vorschaubilder-mit-s: Of that, thumbnails: {zahl} with {platz}. They aren’t backed up and are recreated when needed.
technik.kein-eigenes-volume: – not a volume of its own!
technik.ueberfluessig-aus-der-compose: unnecessary – remove from the Compose file
technik.kopieren-nicht-moeglich-der: Copying isn’t possible (the browser only allows the clipboard over HTTPS or localhost). The text is below for selecting.
technik.fuer-fragen-an-den: For questions to support: copy the overview and paste it into a {link}. Passwords and credentials aren’t in it. How everything fits together is described in {link2}.
technik.was-sich-seit-deiner: What has changed since your version {version}: {link} in the manual, {link2} and {link3} on GitHub.
technik.fragt-github-ablago-endoflife: Asks GitHub (Ablago), endoflife.date (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Alpine) and npm (libraries). Ablago only connects to the internet for this now, at the push of a button.
technik.eine-neuere-ablago-version: A newer Ablago version is available.
technik.fuer-dich-ist-nichts: There’s nothing for you to do.
technik.postgresql-ist-ein-eigenes: PostgreSQL is a separate image (postgres:17) that you pull again separately.
technik.aktualisieren-das-image-enthaelt: Updating: the image {span} contains Node.js, Alpine and the libraries{wert}. Pulling it again and restarting the container is enough.{wert2} The project updates the libraries; they come with the next Ablago update.
verkleinern.die-bisherigen-dateien-werde: The previous files aren’t kept as an older version – the space is freed at once, but the original is gone (except during a retention period).
verkleinern.mit-versionierung-bleibt-das: With versioning the original stays as an older version (space is only freed when it goes). Without versioning the shrunk PDF replaces the previous one, and the previous one goes to the Bin.
verkleinern.gescannte-und-fotografierte-: Scanned and photographed PDFs often contain images with more resolution than you need for reading. Shrinking scales them down and compresses them again; text and full text stay. The size afterwards is estimated.
verkleinern.suche-grosse-pdfs-und: Looking for large PDFs and estimating the savings …
verkleinern.gezeigt-werden-die-groessten: Showing the {alle} largest; the first 60 are estimated.
verkleinern.gibt-den-platz-sofort: – frees the space at once; not during a retention period
verkleinern.originale-nicht-als-aeltere: Don’t keep originals as an older version
verkleinern.wo-die-versionierung-an: Where versioning is on, the original sits next to it as an older version.
verkleinern.hochladen-eingangsordner-pos: Applies to upload, inbox folders, mailboxes, API and WebDAV.
verkleinern.standard-aus-eingeschaltet-w: Default: off. When on, only the shrunk PDF is stored – the original is then not in Ablago. If it saves less than 10 %, the file stays as it came. PDFs edited in Ablago aren’t shrunk automatically.
wartungsmodus.der-beginn-liegt-in: The start is in the past. For right away please use “Lock immediately”.
wartungsmodus.das-erwartete-ende-muss: The expected end must be after the start.
wartungsmodus.ab-jetzt-sehen-alle: From now on everyone sees a notice with a countdown; only people who may administer Ablago can still sign in. {ab}{ab2} everyone else is signed out.{wert}
wartungsmodus.schalte-ihn-vor-einem: {b} Switch it on before an update or a restore. First everyone sees a notice with a countdown and can save their work; then everyone except you is signed out, the API answers with “503”, and text recognition, the daily summary and emptying the Bin pause.
wartungsmodus.wartung-angekuendigt-alle-: Maintenance announced – everyone else will be signed out {wann}.
wartungsmodus.alle-anderen-sind-abgemeld: Everyone else is signed out. Maintenance mode is active.
wartungsmodus.wartungsmodus-beendet-alle: Maintenance mode ended. Everyone can sign in again.
wartungsmodus.alle-anderen-sitzungen-wer: All other sessions end immediately, the API answers with 503. You stay signed in.
wartungsmodus.sofort-gesperrt-alle-ander: Locked immediately: everyone else is signed out, maintenance mode is active.
wartungsmodus.fuer-notfaelle-z-b: For emergencies, e.g. a security incident: everyone is signed out immediately. {hilfe}
verwaltung.ablauf: A planned run on a folder is paused – the person who set it up may no longer carry it out.
werkzeuge.poppler.name: Reading PDFs (Poppler)
werkzeuge.poppler.fehlt: A tool for reading PDFs is missing.
werkzeuge.poppler.folge: So Ablago can't read text from PDFs and can't show page images.
werkzeuge.qpdf.name: Editing PDFs (qpdf)
werkzeuge.qpdf.fehlt: A tool for editing PDFs is missing.
werkzeuge.qpdf.folge: So protected PDFs can't be unlocked, and shrinking makes PDFs less small.
werkzeuge.schriften.name: Substitute fonts (Liberation, DejaVu)
werkzeuge.schriften.folge: PDFs that don't include their fonts (often invoices) therefore appear without text in page images, thumbnails and the archive version. The original and the search are not affected.
werkzeuge.abhilfe_one: The official Ablago image includes it – check that you are using it.
werkzeuge.abhilfe_other: The official Ablago image includes them – check that you are using it.
